_readme: Single source of truth for every colour used across all three workbooks.
Edit this file, re-run the build scripts, redistribute. Nothing here can
be changed by a Refresh All -- colour is baked in at generation time, so
a change here is a 'structural change' in the sense used by the
Management user guide (needs the Build person + redistribution).
Colours accept '#RRGGBB', 'RRGGBB', or 'AARRGGBB'. They are normalised to
Excel's AARRGGBB form on load, so paste corporate hex codes in directly.
Accessibility: every fill/text pair below is contrast-checked against
WCAG 2.1 at build time (see accessibility.min_contrast_ratio). If a
colour you paste in fails, the build stops and tells you which pair and
what ratio it got -- it will not silently ship an unreadable workbook.
Band text colours are chosen automatically for best contrast against
each band fill unless you set 'text' explicitly on that band.
Status colours are additionally paired with Excel icon sets in the
workbooks, so red/amber/green is never the only signal carrying meaning.
